desc: Derive and validate the cost model: only adjacent shifts into a real deficit matter; binary state f_i ∈ {0,k} per letter; O(26) per k, O(26n) total.

Implement the binary-state chain DP: for each k in 1..n, dp over letters 0..25 with two states; recurrence dp_i(f) = A_i(f) + min over g of (dp_{i-1}(g) - min(S_{i-1}(g), D_i(f))); all-f=0 gives cost n fallback.

Verify correctness arguments and cross-check implementation: brute-force BFS comparison on small strings (364/364 match), 'z' boundary, k ≤ n bound, all examples and edge cases, performance O(26n) well within limits for n = 2·10⁴.
